manual.title: Add EBO robot manually
manual.description: No Supervisor detected. Enter the engine's RTSP URL and, for entities, its data API URL + token (see STANDALONE.md).

abort.addon: Robots are being added from the EBO add-on.
abort.setup_started: Setting up — your EBO robots are being added.
abort.no_new_robots: No new robots to add (they're already set up, or none are paired yet).
abort.addon_not_found: Couldn't reach the EBO add-on. Make sure it's installed and running.
abort.invalid_discovery: The add-on sent an invalid discovery message.
